source.title: Verdant Pigment — firsthand Hillsbrad Panda Addon milling totals
source.author: sheppeyescapee

notes: Original player Level 85 Druid; Hillsbrad Foothills, 1 hour, milled herbs with Panda Addon. 284 source-reported Mageroyal herbs, 134 Dusky units and 15 Verdant units. Four herb rows are separate inputs in ONE author/session cohort, NOT four independent authors. Source includes 3 Grave Moss among 732 total gathered herbs (729 in these four processed types) but no per-input completed mill count, per-output occurrence, explicit 0 outcomes, histogram, refund basis, inscription skill or exact patch. Do not use nominal five-herb equivalents as measured casts; pre-modern level-85 epoch, current Retail transfer unverified.

source.title: Ebon Pigment — firsthand pre-patch Ancient Lichen milling aggregate
source.author: rollocola

quote: 22000 Ancient lichen = 13289 Nether pigment and 2337 Ebon pigment
notes: Original source describes pre-patch milling of 22,000 Ancient Lichen herbs, NOT a verified count of completed five-herb mills. Source's 'about 10% chance per herb' is commentary on quantities and not measured per-mill P(hit), so it is not entered as percentShown. 22,000 is gross herb input; actual clicks, refunds, output hit counts, zero outcomes, histograms, inscription skill, client build and which pre-patch epoch all unknown. The two output records share ONE author/cohort, not independent samples.
